title: base_licenses_audit.md
content:
# Licenses Audit

No third-party repository code, model checkpoints, datasets, token images, or audio samples were copied into the final program. The final HTML/CSS/JavaScript is newly generated for this package.

The uploaded repositories had the following visible license/readme findings during inspection:

| Upload | Visible license/readme finding | Included in runtime? |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| `Speech-Accent-Archive-Scraper-main.zip` | MIT License file present. | No |
| `Speech-Accent-Mining-master.zip` | BSD-style license text present; README describes Speech Accent Archive data mining. | No |
| `ThaiSpeechKit-main.zip` | MIT License file present. | No |
| `KhanomTan-TTS-v1.0-main.zip` | Apache License 2.0 file present. | No |
| `LibriTTS-British-Accents-master.zip` | Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license text present; README warns regional accuracy is not guaranteed. | No |
| `thonburian-tts-main.zip` | MIT license and CC-BY-NC-SA license files present. | No |
| `CommonAccent_IS23-main.zip` | README references CommonAccent paper/evaluation code; no copied runtime code. | No |
| `accent-prediction-main.zip` | README references external model download location; no copied runtime code. | No |
| `Kaggle-Kernel-Speech-Accent-Archive-master.zip` | README present but empty/limited in inspected snippet. | No |
| `Accent-Classification--GMU-Speech-Accent-Archive--main.zip` | No top-level license file found in initial zip listing. | No |
| `SpeechAccentArchive-master.zip` | No top-level license file found in initial zip listing. | No |
| `thonburian-tts-api-main.zip` | README references MIT badge/API project; no copied runtime code. | No |
| `Dice Bots.zip` | No license file found in initial zip listing. | No |

## Redistribution status

Because none of the uploaded source code/assets were redistributed, the package does not include third-party license text beyond this audit. If future versions embed token images, audio samples, model weights, or copied source code from any upload, their licenses and attribution requirements should be carried into the package before distribution.
